definitions.explanation: Describes sleeping very deeply and peacefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゆうべ→ゆうべ：02487_yuube⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぐっすり⟦{眠|ねむ}れた→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっすり⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ぐっすり⟦{眠|ねむ}った→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I was tired and slept deeply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぐっすり⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to sleep soundly in the quiet room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ぐっすり⟦{寝|ね}られる→寝る：00470_neru⟧。⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めない→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。
examples.english: After exercising, I always sleep soundly. I don't wake up even once until morning.

notes:
ぐっすり is an onomatopoeic adverb for deep sleep.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぐっすり⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ (to sleep soundly)
- ぐっすり⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep deeply)
- ぐっすり⟦{眠|ねむ}れる→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ (to be able to sleep well)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぐっすり (soundly, deeply)
- ⟦すやすや→すやすや：05783_suyasuya⟧ (peacefully - often for babies)
- ⟦ぐーぐー→ぐーぐー：noentry⟧ (snoring sounds, sleeping)
- ⟦ころっと→ころっと：noentry⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to fall asleep easily)

NOTE: This is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) expressing a state rather than a sound.
